PRECOG_COLD_START_GATE.question: Can previous real startup traces predict the next initialization sequence well enough to reduce cold-start latency without increasing failures or work?
required_data: timestamped real startup event traces with stable component identities
PRECOG_COLD_START_GATE.frozen_split: Chronological train/calibration/holdout split; holdout must remain unseen until model and thresholds are frozen.
promotion_gate: prediction improvement must reproduce on frozen holdout
latency benefit must survive accounting for preload work
failure rate must not worsen beyond preregistered tolerance
independent replay on a later time block

MEMORY_LEAK_OBSERVER_GATE.question: Can a read-only observer distinguish sustained leak-like memory growth from bounded caching, workload bursts and normal GC behavior?
required_data: GC collection counters without forcing collection
controls: intentional bounded cache growth then plateau
promotion_gate: observer must pass all bounded controls without destructive action
known-leak detection reproduced across repeated runs
real-process alert remains advisory until independently verified
